title: Chinese Ink medium-distance pine grove — ArtCraft v7 structural source dossier
intent: Original rooted midground tree group for reusable Shanshui moving films

references.title: Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains — tree and fisherman detail
references.institution: National Palace Museum, Taipei, source image shown by Smarthistory
references.access: Actual 500x500 image visually inspected via source search. Source bytes not bundled; rights not assumed.
references.observed: Five or more spindly upright/leaning tree trunks, staggered in height and position; boughs cross and bend, black foliage marks concentrated near growing ends. Foreground groves form high-density ink islands separated by white paper. No filled triangular canopy polygons.

references.title: Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains — full handscroll
references.observed: Light contour and successive darker, drier ink marks; sparse/dense landscape movement.

shape_graph.roots: Five bases sample the active middle-band ridgeHeight +2.8. No isolated origins.
shape_graph.trunks: 5 individual pressure contours (35–66 film pixels high), with narrow inner bark lines.
shape_graph.branches: 4 per trunk: origins sampled at normalized .31/.5/.67/.84 of each bent trunk.
shape_graph.dark_foliage: 310 short asymmetrical brush taps, rooted on the 20 twig curves, variable length/opacity/width and stemwise polarity. Plus 60 loaded terminal ink pads with independently sampled origins.
shape_graph.negative_space: No filled canopy. Five unequal tree silhouettes with paper gaps between terminal tufts.
shape_graph.hierarchy: Crest silhouette -> planted trunk -> bough -> twig-rooted individual foliage tap.

axes.topology: 5 roots/20 genuine fork roots/310 attached brush marks; no disconnected clusters.
axes.flow: Quadratic crest-connected trunks with asymmetrical lean; terminal branches alternate directions; needle marks follow each bough's local frame.
axes.pressure: rockLoadedRibbon 14-knots for wood; brush taps vary strokeWidth .54–1.13 and opacity .65–.90 plus mist.
axes.rhythm: Five nonuniform trees and four unequal brush patches each. Dark distributed at endpoints and selective loaded taps.
axes.microtexture: Named bark capillary, separate twig fibres and numerous narrow leaf/needle gestures; no generic noise-only material.
